subject: FinServe: sponsor cascade, procurement gates & champion prep
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finserve.com>; Claire Novak <claire.novak@finserve.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Feb 2028 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: FinServe decision path & sponsor cascade — post-demo recap

Samir / Claire — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key decision criteria we heard today:
- Cost per inference and predictable unit economics for pilot workload (~50k tokens/day).
- Data residency / auditability for model inputs (some PHI-like transaction attributes).
- Vendor attestation: SOC 2 Type II + contractual audit rights.
- Integration effort: 2-week sandbox + 1-month pilot.

Confirmed stakeholders from call:
- Champion (day-to-day): Samir Patel (Product Manager) — will own demo & pilot engagement.
- Economic buyer: Claire Novak (SVP, Product) — final approval on spend.
- Procurement: procurement@finserve.com — handles T&Cs and PO.
- Security reviewer: internal infosec team (TBD contact).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Hannah/Ben: send a 1-page ROI summary + champion talk track for Samir by EOD tomorrow. (Attached: first-pass MAP template.)
2) Samir: share procurement timeline and any standard contract clauses to watch for.
3) Lauren: provide security checklist and SOC2 attestation link; flag any redlines we should expect.
4) Schedule: Samir to present pilot ask to Claire the week of Feb 27 — tentatively 30 minutes.

Attachments: FinServe-MAP.xlsx (draft MAP), Security-Checklist-2028.docx (baseline).

If this looks right I'll push the MAP to the shared Drive and schedule the prep session with Samir and Claire.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

Thanks, Hannah — really useful recap. A couple quick clarifications and notes from my side: 

- Confirming Claire is the econ buyer; I can schedule a 30-min readout for Mon 2/27 morning.
- Procurement timeline: procurement expects initial commercial terms before legal review; they typically take 7–10 business days for standard PO + SOW once commercial terms are agreed. Posting their contact in cc.
- Security: infosec will want SOC2 + a short network/data flow diagram. I can introduce you to the lead (Ravi) next week.

Champion ask: I’ll own the pilot narrative but I need a one-pager that makes the ROI case for Claire — top three economic levers and an ask (pilot budget request). Can Ben/Hannah put that together?

Attached: our rough internal timeline (Procurement-Timeline-FS.pdf) — not final.

Samir — attaching a short champion playbook and the 1-page ROI bullets (pulled from similar pilots). Quick highlights you can use in the Claire readout: 

1) Unit economics: estimate 0.6 USD per 1k tokens with Redwood batching + KV cache — projected 35% cost reduction vs current hosted baseline for the pilot workload.
2) Time to value: 2-week sandbox + 4-week pilot with clear success metrics (latency < 300ms p95, error rate < 0.5%, cost per inference target).
3) Risk mitigations: SOC2 attestation in place; we offer prefix caching and on-prem option if data residency is required; escrow + audit clauses available for enterprise plan.

Suggested ask for Claire (what Samir presents):
- Pilot budget: $30k to cover Dedicated capacity + engineering support (4 weeks).
- Commitment: decision on pilot within 2 weeks of readout so procurement can prepare PO.

Samir — would you like me to join the Claire readout to present the econ case (15 mins)? If yes, suggest we schedule a 15-min pre-brief (internal) 48 hours before.

Attachments: Champion-Playbook-FS-1pager.pdf (talk tracks), ROI-Snapshot-FS.pdf

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 21 Feb 2028 14:00:08 -0800
Subject: Re: FinServe decision path & sponsor cascade — security & legal gates

Samir / team — adding the security and legal points you should expect during readout and procurement: 

Security / infosec expectations:
- SOC 2 Type II report (we'll share the latest report and the control matrix).
- Data flow diagram and retention policy (we can provide a template and fill per pilot).
- Access controls / RBAC for any sandbox environment.

Legal / procurement notes:
- Standard exceptions: audit rights, liability cap alignment, data processing addendum (DPA) — procurement will flag these.
- SLA: propose 99.9% availability for Dedicated pilot; if customer needs higher we can scope as an SLA exception (attached draft).

I attached a short checklist and the draft SLA exceptions doc to speed reviews. If procurement has a preferred contract template, please loop it in early so legal can map redlines.

Attachments: Security-Checklist-2028.docx, SLA-Exceptions-Draft.pdf

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
